title: Event journal record
description: One standard event as the durable replay store holds it. Appended before live fan-out, idempotent on eventId, and ordered by (streamEpoch, sequenceNumber, eventId). This is a short-lived transport journal, never conversation history.

scope.description: Opaque conversation-owner identity; adapters compare it but never decompose it.

data.description: Opaque payload, round-tripped byte for byte.
